coverage.native: Car listing, bid, outbid refund, buy-now sale/take, reserve cancellation refund, order cancellation refund, original one-hour winning sale, under-reserve expiry refund and order expiry refund.
coverage.failureReplayConcurrency: Sale/take and reserve-refund rollback; same-key concurrent purchase; worker refund failure with unrelated committed sale retained; concurrent sweep retry; terminal and server-reopen replay.

coverage.native: Offer/take, funded OMR pledge, secondary paper sale, own-debt denial, repayment to new lender, pledge return, offer cancellation, original one-hour collection with car/OMR collateral.
coverage.failureReplayConcurrency: Paper sale and cancellation late-ledger rollback; premature collection denial; late pledge-seizure rollback; concurrent same-key paper purchase and collection; exact and server-reopen replay.

coverage.native: Canonical estate loot and nonloot modes, open loan and market-order disposition, dead standing bid destruction, killer standing-bid refund, OMR collateral split, actual heir, inherited lender claim and repayment, dead entrant stakes destruction.
coverage.failureReplayConcurrency: Late estate pledge-disposition abort retains all observed state; dead-identity retry denied; stale prior event-entry receipts after actual succession carry no new value.
coverage.limitation: Canonical runEstate is called through withTwoCharacters with explicit terminal mode; natural combat eligibility and fire-earned kill are unexecuted.

coverage.group: poker, Grand Prix and Stakes pools
coverage.native: Canonical paid entry; full-field winner/take/dead-entrant terminal branch; distinct short-field refund branch; original GP and Stakes registration deadlines, plus declared initial empty 60-second poker fixture.
coverage.failureReplayConcurrency: Concurrent same-key entries, stored replay, fresh-key duplicate denial; actual sweep late-ledger failure; concurrent terminal workers; direct and worker terminal retries; server reopen.
coverage.limitation: Original poker 24-hour lifetime and bracket format remain unexecuted.

dependencyCaveat: Installed Node dependencies were shared with the local repository and not independently attested. These runs prove their recorded source revision and local PostgreSQL execution only; they are not evidence for a later integrated revision.

rerun.prerequisite: Clean pinned checkout; RC1_RESOURCE_DATABASE_URL points to an isolated local PostgreSQL administrative database; private RC1_RESOURCE_OUTPUT optional.

privacy: Only source/run identities, declared fixture roles, public branch names, numeric aggregates, timestamps and hashes. No raw actor identities, authentication tokens, signed credentials, request bodies, connection strings or private paths.
